title: 2023 Madeiran regional election
summary: Madeira elected its regional assembly on 24 September 2023, returning the Social Democrats under Miguel Albuquerque without a majority. The government that followed lasted four months: Albuquerque was named as a suspect in a corruption investigation and resigned on 5 February 2024, and because the constitution forbids dissolving an assembly in the first six months of a legislature, the president could not call an election until 27 March. It is in the atlas as the first of three Madeiran elections in eighteen months, and because the six-month rule visible in it is what fixed the date of the second.

actors.role: returned to the regional government without a majority
